name: @opening-cross/identity-attester
description: Two attesters for cross_gate. The devnet test attester signs a SAS attestation for a wallet that proves it controls the wallet (no identity check). The KYC attester turns what an identity provider says about a wallet (Cleanverse A-Pass, or a manual allowlist) into the oc-identity attestation cross_gate reads, keeps it true and closes it when the provider stops vouching.
